0022600184.text: The San Antonio Spurs (4-2, 2-2 at home, on a four-game winning streak) host the Dallas Mavericks (4-2, 2-1 at home, on a three-game winning streak) as both teams sit 2 games back in their divisions, with the Spurs 3rd in the Southwest and 5th in the West and Dallas 4th in the Southwest and 7th in the West. San Antonio leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-106 win in Dallas on 2026-10-24, and the Spurs also won the 2025-26 series 4-0. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), while the Mavericks are missing Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (out, knee), Santi Aldama (out, knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation).
